name: Tycoon2FA adversary emulation plan
description: A simple, SAFE adversary emulation plan for Tycoon2FA, ordered initial access -> persistence -> data exfiltration, mapped to MITRE ATT&CK and written in the MITRE CALDERA profile style. Every step is a harmless placeholder (a logged echo), not a real attack command. The plan doubles as a test of our own detections (Weeks 3, 5, 7).

steps.procedure: Send a lure email with a link / QR code / SVG that points to the AiTM proxy.
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] sent lure email with link to AiTM proxy (no real email sent)'
steps.our_detection: E-mail gateway + Week 2-3 URL/domain IOCs; YARA on HTML/SVG attachments

steps.procedure: Reverse proxy relays the victim's login to the real identity provider in real time.
steps.safe_command: python3 attack_sim/aitm_lab.py  # the Week 6 safe localhost lab
steps.our_detection: Week 6 simulation reproduces it; relay IP IOCs; Shodan fingerprint pivot

steps.procedure: Capture the live one-time MFA code as it passes through the proxy.
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] captured fake MFA code 314159 in transit'
steps.our_detection: Inferred from the result: successful sign-in from attacker infra (Week 5 H1)

steps.procedure: Steal the authenticated session cookie issued after MFA succeeds.
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] stole dummy session cookie ACME-SESSION-xxxx'
steps.our_detection: Week 5 Sigma: successful sign-in with axios/node-fetch User-Agent

steps.procedure: Register a new MFA method / device so access survives a password reset.
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] registered attacker authenticator app / device (PRT)'
steps.our_detection: Week 5 hunt H1 + Sigma correlation (non-browser sign-in -> new MFA within 60 min)

steps.procedure: Enumerate the tenant with a burst of Microsoft Graph calls (roles, users, contacts).
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] 42 Graph calls to 12 endpoints in 36s (recon)'
steps.our_detection: Week 5 hunt H3: Graph reconnaissance burst (>=20 calls, >=8 endpoints in 60s)

steps.procedure: Read and collect the victim's mailbox and contact list for the next wave.
steps.our_detection: Mailbox audit logs; concurrent-session CAR analytic (Week 7)

steps.procedure: Create an inbox rule that deletes/hides finance mail to hide the fraud.
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] created inbox rule: delete invoice,payroll -> hidden'
steps.our_detection: Week 5 hunt H2: delete/hide inbox rule after a risky sign-in

steps.procedure: Send the stolen cookie and data out over a web service (Telegram bot).
steps.safe_command: echo '[emulate] exfiltrated dummy data to attacker channel (simulated Telegram)'
steps.our_detection: Block Telegram API egress; relay-IP IOCs; CAR concurrent-session analytic
